analysis:
This batch holds documentation only. The first file is a new changelog fragment, changelog.d/provider-update-rollback.md lines 1-7. The second is docs/operations/provider-release.md: the date bump on base line 3 and a new paragraph at head lines 1033-1040.

The docs describe a new local `darkbloom update --rollback` path:
- It keeps the prior signed release and restores it through the watchdog's journaled swap under the update lease.
- It quarantines the rolled-back version locally; `--override-quarantine` reinstalls it.
- It contacts no coordinator.
- It refuses when the kept release fails its hash or signature check.

No implementation source (updater, watchdog, quarantine store) is in this batch, so I cannot verify these claims.

Threat-model relevance:
- T-043 (watchdog rollback authority is the same replaceable binary) and TB-003 (operator vs process). Rollback is operator-initiated on the operator's own Mac. The operator is already the adversary ADV-001 and can already replace the binary (T-013).
- Downgrading to an older signed build is a new operator capability. It does not bypass coordinator controls: serving still requires current registered and qualified identity (TB-011, T-054, A-017), and permanent revocation via the admin endpoint remains coordinator-enforced.
- The doc correctly distinguishes deactivation from revocation (head lines 1033-1043).

Integration and next-pass questions on the implementation:
1. Whether the kept release is re-verified against the self-updater's designated requirement (DarkbloomCodeSignature) and hashes at restore time, not only at keep time.
2. Whether the kept-bundle and quarantine storage location is protected against a same-UID local process planting a bundle. That is pre-existing operator power, but relevant to T-043/T-061.
3. Whether rollback to a build the coordinator has revoked or deactivated is still refused at serving time. Expected via the coordinator, but unverified here.
4. Whether a quarantine record can be abused to block security updates. Only an exact version is quarantined and newer versions install, per changelog line 5.
5. Whether rollback respects the update lease and avoids races with the watchdog's auto-rollback.

The threat model may need a T-043 update to mention the operator rollback path and the kept-release store.
